title: Watch "Avatar: Fire and Ash" with Disney+ and Hulu — get up to 50% off this streaming bundle
summary: Save $11.99 a month on two of the best streaming services out there, home to not only the latest Avatar blockbuster, but Star Wars, Marvel, Alien and more.
contentText:
Avatar: Fire and Ash, the third instalment of James Cameron’s epic saga, has just landed not on the alien moon Pandora, but Disney+.

Get a Disney+ and Hulu bundle subscription for just $11.99 a month, that's 50% cheaper per month!

Sam Worthington reprised his iconic role as the Na'vi leader Jake Sully for Avatar: Fire and Ash , and he is confirmed to continue portraying the character in the upcoming fourth and fifth instalments of the franchise. Although with release dates of December 2029 and the fifth instalment pencilled in for December 2031, we'll have to wait a while.

In the meantime, there are plenty of sci-fi movies and series to enjoy on Disney Plus, including the original Avatar (the highest-grossing movie of all time), plus Avatar 2: The Way of Water, and behind-the-scenes documentary Fire and Water: Making the Avatar Films.

For less than the price of your morning coffee and a bagel or two, you'll get access (with ads) to both Disney Plus and Hulu , two popular streaming services that feature thousands of movies, box sets and all your favorite sci-fi series and films.

Both services are fantastic choices for fans of sci-fi, with new content being added regularly, including Star Wars, Marvel, and Alien: Earth, the Alien TV series, which will be available to stream on Hulu. You also get access to Disney's huge library of original content and animated classics from them and Pixar.

For the stargazers out there who are also sports fans, you can also access the ESPN+ offerings by signing up for the Disney Plus, Hulu and ESPN+ bundle for $35.99 — which is a 33% saving over the usual cost of signing up to all three services. ESPN+ has a wide variety of live sports, original shows, and on-demand content, including NFL, NHL, MLB, and PGA Tour golf, as well as various international soccer leagues.

You can browse all of our streaming deals on our hub page, but we think this is one of the best deals out there.

Key features: All Avatar movies, plus Star Wars and Marvel films and series, plus hundreds of movies and box sets, including lots of sci-fi content.

Price history: It's been as low as $2.99 a month for the Duo Basic bundle, but if you missed out on that, this bundle price is still a great value for money option when compared to signing up individually to each service ($23.98)

Consensus: We love both Disney Plus and Hulu, and if you're a sci-fi fan, Disney, in particular, is hard to beat. The Disney-owned content alone makes it worth the asking price but there's still a whole catalog of great content to scroll through. On Hulu, you have another huge library to choose from, and they have big sci-fi titles in their collection.

Tom's Guide: ★★★★ | TechRadar: ★★★★

✅ Buy it if: You want unlimited access to sci-fi content from Star Wars to Marvel, along with hundreds of other sci-fi box sets and movies.

❌ Don't buy it if: You don't watch much TV. But then, you probably wouldn't consider any streaming deal if that were the case.
